{{Quote|Variations of diplurans are found on almost all habitable worlds. It's this particular species that is interesting. During various parts of its life cycle, it excretes a certain fluid rich with pheromones. These pheromones happen to be a powerful hallucinogen for some mammalian species. From what records survive, the hallucinations were terrifying.|[[Natua Wan]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
'''Rhak-skuri''', which translated from the ancient [[Sith (language)|Sith]] as '''"Dream Singer"''', were a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith alchemy/Legends|twisted]] sub-species of [[Diplura]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Upekzar]]. The insectoid rhak-skuri excreted powerful [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] that induced terrifying hallucinations in mammalian [[Species/Legends|species]], and [[Diet/Legends|fed]] not only on flesh, but on the terror of their victims&mdash;including [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].
